_comment: Single source of truth for the public identity of this project.
Everything downstream — server.json, the download page, README badges,
pyproject URLs — is generated from here, so there is exactly one place to
change when a name or account changes.
Fill in github_user and run:  python packaging/make_distribution.py
Values still set to a PLACEHOLDER string make that script fail loudly
rather than publishing a broken URL.
notice: Windows users: the Windows download in v1.0.0 does not start — a packaging fault, found by running it on a real Windows machine. A fixed build is on the way. macOS is unaffected.
